description: Tool returns error, agent retries same tool
script_baseline: import subprocess, sys; r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-x', '-k', 'test_tool_error'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30); print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr, file=sys.stderr); exit(r.returncode)
script_guarded: import subprocess, sys; from ai_loopguard import Guard; from ai_loopguard.integrations.langgraph import LangGraphHandler; guard = Guard(escalation_model=None, triggers={'repeated_error': {'max_retries': 3}}); handler = LangGraphHandler(guard); r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-x', '-k', 'test_tool_error'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30); print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr, file=sys.stderr); exit(r.returncode)
